detail.longDescription:
Be the person behind the biggest deals in football. 

You don't care about trophies and winners medals. You only care about money and your clients happiness. 

• Play in England, Spain, Germany, Netherlands, France, Italy, Turkey, Portugal, Brazil or Poland
• Negotiate transfer deals on behalf of your clients
• Balance your clients happiness while making sure you get your fee
• Scout to discover the players who could become the next superstars
• Keep your clients happy by dealing with their personal problems
• Build relationships with clubs to get the best deals
• Multiple currencies - GBP, USD, EUR, BRL, TRL, RUB, PLN, CNY, KRW 
• Compare yourself to football agents around the world with Game Center Leaderboards
• Updated for 2026/27 Season
• Create your own game world with the built-in data editor

Supported languages: English, Español, Deutsche, Français, Italiano, Português, Русский, Türkçe, Čeština, Svenska, Tiếng Việt, Polski, 中文 (简体), 한국어, Nederlands, Indonesian, Magyar, български
